name: washing-instructions
title: Washing instructions
description: One row per pile of laundry. Every machine-facing value is a setting the Generic front loader can actually be turned to.

fields.name: clothing_type
fields.title: Pile
fields.description: What you call the pile. This becomes the heading on its card.

fields.name: detergent
fields.title: Detergent
fields.description: Which detergent, and how much of it.

fields.name: fabric_softener
fields.title: Fabric softener
fields.description: Whether softener goes in. Written yes or no.

fields.name: temperature
fields.title: Temperature
fields.description: A temperature the display steps through. koud is the snowflake.

fields.name: spin
fields.title: Spin speed
fields.description: Spin in rpm. 0 is drain without spinning.

fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: Roughly how long the programme runs, for planning the day around it.

fields.name: program
fields.title: Programme
fields.description: A dial position, spelled exactly as it is printed on the fascia.

fields.name: options
fields.title: Option buttons
fields.description: Option buttons to press, pipe-separated. Empty for none.

fields.name: ironing
fields.title: Iron this?
fields.description: Whether this pile gets ironed at all.

fields.name: ironing_notes
fields.title: Ironing notes
fields.description: Prose: how to iron it, or why you don't. Often empty.

fields.name: iron_setting
fields.title: Iron thermostat
fields.description: Where the iron's thermostat points. Empty when ironing is no.

fields.name: colour_group
fields.title: Colour group
fields.description: Which piles it may share a drum with on colour grounds. any mixes with all.

fields.name: mix_tags
fields.title: Mixing tags
fields.description: Reasons this pile cannot share a drum even when the settings agree, pipe-separated.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Anything else worth knowing while you are standing at the machine.
